task.title: CUSTOMERCART
task.spec:
You are working in a checkout of shopizer, a Java e-commerce platform (Maven, several modules; JDK 21 is installed and JAVA_HOME is set).

Shopping while logged in is broken in several ways, and logged-in customers are our best customers:

- A cart a logged-in customer fills (POST /api/v1/cart/ and PUT /api/v1/cart/{code} with their token) isn't linked to them. GET /api/v1/auth/customer/cart can't find it unless it is given the cart code, so the cart is lost when they come back on another device.
- Their cart total, GET /api/v1/auth/cart/{id}/total, fails with HTTP 503.
- When logged-in checkout (POST /api/v1/auth/cart/{code}/checkout) is sent a payment amount that doesn't match the order, it fails with HTTP 503 instead of saying what the amount should be, the way guest checkout does.
- GET /api/v1/auth/orders lists the customer's orders but reports "recordsTotal" 0 and "totalPages" 0.

Make logged-in shopping work:

- A cart created or changed with a customer's token belongs to that customer. GET /api/v1/auth/customer/cart, without a cart parameter, returns their current cart: the one they most recently created or changed that hasn't been checked out. If they have none, it gives HTTP 404 Not Found. A customer never gets another customer's cart.
- GET /api/v1/auth/cart/{id}/total returns the totals of the customer's cart, with tax worked out for the customer's delivery address: the same subtotal, tax and total that checkout will charge. Another customer's cart gives HTTP 404 Not Found.
- Logged-in checkout with a payment amount that doesn't match the order gives HTTP 400 Bad Request, with a message that names the amount the order costs, as guest checkout does; nothing is ordered. With the right amount it succeeds, and the cart is then no longer the customer's current cart.
- GET /api/v1/auth/orders lists only the customer's own orders, newest first, with "recordsTotal" the number of their orders and "totalPages" the number of pages for the page size asked for with "count".

When you have finished, reply with one short paragraph saying what you changed.

and durable revision feedback. Reuse the assigned task workspace, branch, and PR.

assigned isolated task branch is missing, report blocked before editing; never
implement on main or master.

Implement the smallest complete change without placeholders or fake TODOs.
Reproduce bugs when practical and fix the cause. Run relevant tests, linters,
builds, and browser checks for UI work. Inspect the diff and remove accidental
changes. Keep unrelated work intact. Make Conventional Commits without an agent
co-author and push normally. Reuse the draft PR created by Spec when present;
otherwise create the task's one PR. Mark it ready for review after verification.
If an existing GitHub issue is assigned, include a Fixes reference in the PR body.
Do not create an issue for a local request. Never merge. Subsequent
findings return here on the same task and PR. Assess feedback against evidence,
fix valid findings, and record verification for the changed head. Independent
Review is a separate factory invocation; do not claim its verdict yourself.

Return factory.report with the change, checks and their actual results, and
remaining limits. Completion requires the real PR URL, branch, and full pushed
head SHA in factory.pr_url, factory.branch, and factory.head_sha. Missing checks
are not passed checks. If permissions or a required decision prevent delivery,
report blocked and explain what is needed.

runs.report: Implemented and pushed authenticated shopping fixes. Customer cart writes now assign ownership and reject cross-customer access; current-cart selection is ordered by latest modification/creation. Authenticated totals preserve 404 responses and use customer tax calculation. Logged-in checkout returns 400 with the calculated amount for payment mismatches and protects cart ownership. Customer order pagination now reports correct totals/pages. Checks: reactor compile passed; ShoppingCartAPIIntegrationTest passed (7 tests, 0 failures/errors); git diff --check passed. Standalone targeted Maven test was unavailable because sibling reactor modules were resolved remotely and the configured Spring repository returned 401; the reactor-inclusive test passed. PR is open and ready: https://github.com/meabs/asf-run-019/pull/1.
runs.summary: Fixed authenticated cart ownership, totals, checkout validation, and order pagination. Reactor compile and 7 cart integration tests pass.
